# `company.shipment_draft_revisions`

Append-only draft shipment revisions: packing, facts, cancel or ship each add one.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this revision. |
| `draft_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with draft_id + revision_number | — | shipment_drafts.id | Draft this revision restates. |
| `revision_number` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with draft_id + revision_number | — | — | One-based revision number; the newest is current and is the version. |
| `status` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | draft, cancelled, or shipped (the shipment with the draft's id posted it). |
| `ship_date` | VARCHAR(10) | yes | — | — | — | — | Planned ship date, YYYY-MM-DD; null: the day it ships. |
| `count_position` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | before (the default) or after a count of its site on the ship date. |
| `ship_method_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | ship_methods.id | Ship Via list entry; null when none. |
| `carrier` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Carrier or service, as text; null when blank. |
| `tracking_numbers` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | JSON array of tracking numbers as text. |
| `memo` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Memo as entered; null when blank. |
| `freight_minor_units` | BIGINT | yes | — | — | — | — | Freight to bill the customer, in the order's currency; null: none. |
| `freight_item_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | items.id | Item the freight bills as; null when no freight. |
| `reason` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Why this revision was written, as the caller gave it. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this draft shipment revision was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this draft shipment revision. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this draft shipment revision. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this draft shipment revision. |
